en: Yusuke-kun, you study art, right?{PAGE}If you don't mind, do you think you{SAUT}could give me some drawing tips?
Are you interested in art as well,{SAUT}Amagi-san?
Mhm. I was thinking I could put it on{SAUT}display at our inn... What do you think?
Good idea.{OPTION}It might draw in customers.{OPTION}Why don't you help her out?
Hm. Something drawn by the manager{SAUT}herself might help the inn grow more{SAUT}popular.{PAGE}Very well. I am still in training,{SAUT}but if it's all right with you,{SAUT}then I accept.
Thank you!{PAGE}...So what do we do now?
First, I'd like to know what kind of picture{SAUT}you wish to draw.{PAGE}You may use whatever you{SAUT}like as a motif.
Got it!
What do you think?
Looks good.{OPTION}Looks good enough to eat.
It's not bad at all, and...{PAGE}It perfectly encapsulates the natural{SAUT}beauty of its curved shape. You've quite{SAUT}the eye.
You're right. I must admit it's{SAUT}starting to make me hungry...
Shrimp are great, aren't they? They're{SAUT}delicious, and they're fun to look at!{PAGE}You can make any parfait look gorgeous{SAUT}just by placing a few shrimp on top.
A shrimp parfait? I suppose there are still{SAUT}many dishes I've yet to learn about...{PAGE}As for your drawing...{PAGE}Amagi-san... Might you be{SAUT}holding yourself back?
Wha―!?
It's by no means a bad picture, but this{SAUT}shrimp seems somewhat restricted...
Restricted...?
Release your inner self! Let your pencil{SAUT}guide you!{PAGE}Now, face the shrimp again! What does{SAUT}it mean to you!?
Huh!? Face the shrimp? What does it{SAUT}mean to me...?
Sh-Shrimp... Shrimp...{PAGE}Shrimp, shrimp... SHRIMP!
Yes... That's the look! That's the feeling!{SAUT}Put it all on the canvas!
Right! I'll try!
Th-This is...!
Wh-What do you think? I feel like I was{SAUT}really able to capture the essence of the{SAUT}shrimp...
That's a shrimp?{OPTION}You have quite a knack for this.{OPTION}I don't follow...
H-How could this be... To think I called{SAUT}myself an artist!
Huh? I-Is it bad?
Bad!? Quite the opposite! I can{SAUT}feel your passion! This shrimp{SAUT}defies all expectation!{PAGE}I want to see more of your art,{SAUT}Amagi-san!
That's nice of you to say, but I don't{SAUT}know what else to draw...
I see... So you need a motif that's just as{SAUT}moving as the shrimp?
Huh? Um... Yeah.
Then, I will find it for you. When I do,{SAUT}I'd like you to sketch for me again!
Heeey! I heard there's a new{SAUT}ticket available.{PAGE}Hm? What're you smirking at,{SAUT}Inari? Anyway, let's go!
